## Company Overview

MH Construction, Inc. is a BBB Accredited, veteran-owned general contractor based in Pasco, Washington. Founded in 2010 and operating from the Tri-Cities region, the company serves commercial, industrial, governmental, agricultural, winery, and tenant-improvement projects across Washington, Oregon, and Idaho. The company is known for clear planning, direct communication, and accountable project delivery. Its core slogan is "Built on Quality, Backed by Trust." The operating promise is "No gaps. No guesswork. Just accountable follow-through."

MH Construction was founded by Mike Holstein and transitioned to veteran-owned leadership in January 2025 when Jeremy Thamert acquired the company. Jeremy serves as Owner & President and brings Army veteran leadership, disciplined operations, and a relationship-first approach to project execution. Arnold Garcia serves as Vice President and supports field coordination, stakeholder relationships, and delivery depth.

## Operating Approach

The company’s operating style is grounded in four values: Honesty, Integrity, Professionalism, and Thoroughness. These values guide scope clarity, realistic scheduling, transparent communication, and practical follow-through from preconstruction through closeout. MH Construction is known for disciplined coordination, careful planning, and dependable execution in occupied, regulated, and complex project environments.

## Core Services and Markets

- Commercial construction
- Industrial construction and facility upgrades
- Pre-engineered metal buildings (PEMB)
- Tenant improvements and remodels
- Public-sector and government construction support
- Design-build, construction management, and preconstruction planning
- Agricultural and winery facility work
- Municipal and public-works-adjacent project delivery

## Service Area

MH Construction serves clients across the Pacific Northwest from its Tri-Cities headquarters in Pasco, Richland, and Kennewick. The company is licensed in Washington, Oregon, and Idaho and regularly works in cities and counties including Pasco, Richland, Kennewick, Yakima, Spokane, Walla Walla, Hermiston, Pendleton, Coeur d’Alene, Omak, Benton County, Franklin County, and surrounding communities.

## Trust, Credentials, and Proof

- BBB Accredited Business with an A+ rating (accredited April 7, 2026)
- Veteran-owned business with Army veteran leadership
- AGC membership and support for BABAA-related public-sector compliance awareness
- Strong safety and operational discipline, including OSHA VPP Star recognition and AGC-WA EMR award history
- A documented record of 650+ completed projects and a high referral rate built through repeat partnerships
